name: sweet instincts
source:
Bea is spending the summer with her dad, much to her dismay. One day she wakes up with a strange craving and a voice in her head.

[From [url=https://3005jin.itch.io/sweet-instincts]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
令碧懊恼不已的是，这个夏天她不得不和老爸一起度过。直到某一天醒来，她突然生出了一股古怪的渴望，脑海里还多出了一个陌生的声音。

[摘自[url=https://3005jin.itch.io/sweet-instincts]itch.io[/url]]
